_note: Episode 18 (S2E10) keyframes. Present-day Acapulco (no dog: Usman exists only in the jump light and in the past) and an unnamed galleon-era night in Acapulco reached by the jump; 1565 is seen only through the lens. Real people (Urdaneta, the crew, Legazpi, Rajah Tupas) are generic figures from behind or with faces turned away; Tupas's diwa is light only. The nahual is shown as an old man in a sombrero and as a jaguar; never killed. Copied: full intro, sandugo_seal, holo_bar, notebook_glow (Episode 11); usman_return, scott_glass (Episode 10). Shots follow sentences.json; k80-k89 are montage extras. Framing labels in shots_fx.json; 'depth': 'strong' for the 3D camera moves. No weapons.
